_readme: FairFee terms used by the calculator on fairfee.html. Buyer cash back is prorated: rebatePer dollars per rebateStep of purchase price ($1,000 per $400,000, so $750 on $300,000).

selling.note: The buyer’s brokerage rate is what’s offered to the agent who brings the buyer. You choose it with us before listing.

buying.note: Cash back is paid by our brokerage after closing. Your lender must be told about it. Conditions are set out in the buyer representation agreement. Closing costs are an estimate (legal fees, title insurance and adjustments); your lawyer will confirm the final amount. Ottawa has no municipal land transfer tax.
